intent: Cluster test covering the basic leader lifecycle: cluster comes up leading/following, failover on leader stop, leader restart reclaiming leadership, and a follower resynchronizing after falling behind while stopped.

objects.name: LeadingTest::clusterUp
objects.role: polls until node 0 leads and 1/2 follow

objects.name: LeadingTest::failover
objects.role: stops node 0, waits for node 1 to lead

objects.name: LeadingTest::standDownTimeout
objects.role: verifies a stuck HTTPS request doesn't block stand-down; commented out of the TEST() list and never runs

objects.name: LeadingTest::restoreLeader
objects.role: restarts node 0, waits for the original layout to return

objects.name: LeadingTest::synchronizing
objects.role: stops a follower, writes 5000 rows, restarts it and confirms SYNCHRONIZING before FOLLOWING

misfits.why: fully implemented test method permanently disabled via a comment ('Disabled for speed') rather than removed or gated, so it never runs as part of the suite
